shots.line: Le pays qui mange le plus de piment au monde…
shots.scene: TITLE over establishing wide: Indian spice market at golden hour, mountains of red chilies in baskets, crowd, hanging chili strings blurred in fg; TOI (mustard) in the middle holding up one big red chili. Title 'LE PIMENT' + 'PAS INDIEN ?!' (thumbnail, no captions)

shots.line: ne l'a découvert qu'il y a cinq cents ans.
shots.scene: giant face TOI shocked, chili in front of his face, market blurred behind; gold '500 ANS' counts up on 'cinq cents'

shots.line: Ce pays, c'est l'Inde.
shots.scene: kitchen wide: CUISINIERE stirring a pot of red curry, chilies drying on the window sill, steam; pill 'INDE' pops on 'l'Inde'

shots.line: Et le piment ?
shots.scene: insert macro: one red chili spinning slowly on dark, red glow, a big '?' fades in

shots.line: Il vient du Mexique.
shots.scene: whip to Mexico: wide field of chili plants with red pods at sunset, mountains; pill 'MEXIQUE' on 'Mexique'

shots.line: Là-bas, on le cultive depuis environ
shots.scene: medium: PAYSAN (green headband) kneels between chili plants, picks red pods into a woven basket, warm rim light

shots.line: six mille ans.
shots.scene: data card: gold '6 000 ANS' counter over a time ribbon, a chili plant growing from seed to fruit beside it

shots.line: En 1493, Christophe Colomb
shots.scene: 3D: Columbus's caravel on a dusk sea, slow orbit; gold '1493' tag

shots.line: le goûte aux Caraïbes.
shots.scene: beach medium: a Taino host (plain ink) hands COLOMB (purple coat) a red chili; he bites; pill 'CARAÏBES'

shots.line: Il croit avoir trouvé le poivre des Indes…
shots.scene: giant face COLOMB thinking/smirk, thought bubble showing black peppercorns

shots.line: et il l'appelle « pimiento » :
shots.scene: insert: Columbus's hand ties a paper tag 'PIMIENTO' onto the red chili

shots.line: poivre.
shots.scene: blueprint split: red chili left, black peppercorn right, '= POIVRE ?' between them

shots.line: Mauvais pays, mauvais nom.
shots.scene: FREEZE FRAME: COLOMB frozen mid-bite on the beach, particles hanging, cool tint; coral crosses 'MAUVAIS PAYS' then 'MAUVAIS NOM'

shots.line: Mais le nom va rester.
shots.scene: today: TOI in a kitchen reads a spice jar labelled 'PIMENT' full of red chilies, shrugs with a smile

shots.line: Ensuite, ce sont les marins portugais qui l'emportent partout.
shots.scene: 3D: Portuguese carrack at a golden harbour, MARIN (blue) carries a crate of red chilies up the plank, other sailors in ink

shots.line: Le long des côtes d'Afrique…
shots.scene: blueprint map: dotted route draws from Lisbon down the African coast, a tiny chili rides the head of the route

shots.line: jusqu'à Goa, en Inde, au début du seizième siècle.
shots.scene: Goa harbour at dusk: the ship at the quay, MARIN hands a basket of chilies to CUISINIERE; pill 'GOA' then gold 'XVIe SIÈCLE'

shots.line: Avant ça, en Inde, ce qui piquait,
shots.scene: dip back in time: dim kitchen, CUISINIERE grinds on a stone, no chili anywhere, she fans her mouth

shots.line: c'était le poivre noir.
shots.scene: insert macro: black peppercorns pour into a brass bowl; label 'AVANT : POIVRE NOIR'

shots.line: Le piment s'installe d'abord dans le sud…
shots.scene: blueprint India map: pin 'SUD', chili plants sprout around it

shots.line: et il lui faudra deux siècles pour atteindre le nord.
shots.scene: golden wide landscape: a farmer (ink) walks north carrying a chili basket, sun and moon sweep across the sky (time passing); gold '2 SIÈCLES'; arrow to 'NORD'

shots.line: À Goa, on l'appelait même le « poivre de Pernambouc »,
shots.scene: Goa market: CUISINIERE behind a chili crate with a hand-painted sign 'POIVRE DE PERNAMBOUC', shoppers in ink

shots.line: du nom d'une région du Brésil.
shots.scene: whip to the Brazilian coast: palms, sugar-white beach, a Portuguese ship offshore; pill 'PERNAMBOUC · BRÉSIL'

shots.line: Aujourd'hui, l'Inde est le premier producteur,
shots.scene: 3D wide: today's Indian fields, huge red carpets of drying chilies, workers raking; gold '1er PRODUCTEUR'

shots.line: le premier consommateur
shots.scene: medium: TOI at a family table in India, plates of red curry, everyone eating; '1er CONSOMMATEUR'

shots.line: et le premier exportateur de piment au monde.
shots.scene: harbour today: sacks of chilies swung onto a cargo ship by crane; '1er EXPORTATEUR', then the three '1er' stack

shots.line: Alors la prochaine fois qu'un plat te brûle la bouche…
shots.scene: giant face TOI biting a red chili, eyes watering, steam from the ears, red glow

shots.line: remercie le Mexique.
shots.scene: Mexican field at sunset: TOI raises a chili toward PAYSAN, who waves back; big 'MERCI, MEXIQUE'
END CARD: chili field dims, The World Menu badge, mustard pill 'Abonne-toi pour le prochain plat', teaser for the next dish; whole cast lined up holding chilies
